verdict.rationale: Rippling documents a first-party v2 REST API at rest.ripplingapis.com. It uses Bearer tokens with scopes, dated version pinning, cursor pagination and an official npm SDK, so programmatic access is real. Nothing shows the API covers what the UI does for IT functions such as device management, inventory, app/identity policies or workflows; the only documented call is 'List companies'. missing for 10: evidence of UI–API parity, documented IT-specific endpoints (devices, inventory, access policies, workflows), write/action coverage, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI

citations.quote: Search and filter the full v2 REST API.
Access is the intersection of the owner’s permission profile and the token’s scopes.
Pin a dated API version with the `Rippling-Api-Version` header (`YYYY-MM-DD`).
